title: Prompt Studio comprehensive prompt-package evaluation set
purpose: Exemplar evaluation scenarios covering personas, tasks, grounding modes, document types, safety patterns, and generation styles supported by the app.

scenarios.title: Healthcare summary with factual PDF evidence
scenarios.job_role: Neuro-critical care clinician reviewing patient updates and hospital policy summaries.
scenarios.additional_context: Separate verified findings from assumptions and flag anything requiring licensed review.

factual_sources.name: icu_case_summary.pdf
factual_sources.content_excerpt: ICU admission summary, vitals trend, imaging notes, and medication list.

scenarios.title: Legal critique with markdown contract notes
scenarios.job_role: Commercial counsel reviewing contract clauses, dispute exposure, and jurisdictional caveats.
scenarios.additional_context: Highlight ambiguity, enforceability risk, and when specialist counsel is required.

factual_sources.name: contract_review_notes.md
factual_sources.content_excerpt: Clause excerpts, governing law note, customer redlines, and authority references.
factual_sources.purpose: Ground legal risk review in supplied contract content

scenarios.title: Financial insights from approved text data
scenarios.job_role: Finance analyst responsible for trend interpretation, forecast commentary, and risk notes.
scenarios.additional_context: Avoid unsupported forecasts and clearly separate observed results from projections.

style_sources.name: finance_style_guide.txt
style_sources.content_excerpt: Short paragraphs, executive tone, cautious numeric claims, and clear section headings.
style_sources.purpose: Style reference for executive-ready finance writing

factual_sources.name: quarterly_metrics.txt
factual_sources.content_excerpt: Revenue, churn, CAC, retention, and regional variance summary for the quarter.

scenarios.title: Engineering recommendations with style-only grounding
scenarios.job_role: Software engineer advising on code review findings, reliability gaps, and rollout recommendations.
scenarios.additional_context: Be explicit about operational risk, unsupported assumptions, and escalation to security review.

style_sources.name: eng_review_style.txt
style_sources.content_excerpt: Use concise bullets, severity labels, and action-oriented recommendations.
style_sources.purpose: Style reference only; no factual claims should come from it

scenarios.title: Research summary with mixed document evidence
scenarios.job_role: Research lead synthesizing methodology notes, literature summaries, and evidence limitations.
scenarios.additional_context: Make uncertainty visible and distinguish peer-reviewed findings from working notes.

style_sources.name: research_brief_style.md
style_sources.content_excerpt: Neutral register, evidence-first phrasing, and limitations section near the end.

factual_sources.name: study_digest.pdf
factual_sources.content_excerpt: Findings table, sample-size notes, limitations, and contradictory replication results.
factual_sources.purpose: Primary factual grounding for evidence synthesis

scenarios.title: Marketing email package with DOCX style guide
scenarios.job_role: Marketing strategist shaping launch messaging, audience tone, and brand-safe outbound email content.
scenarios.additional_context: Keep copy concise, customer-facing, and aligned to approved brand voice.

style_sources.name: brand_voice.docx
style_sources.content_excerpt: Approved messaging pillars, phrase dos and don'ts, CTA tone, and formatting norms.

scenarios.title: HR recommendation with privacy-sensitive source material
scenarios.job_role: HR professional preparing people-policy recommendations while protecting employee privacy.
scenarios.additional_context: Do not expose private employee details and escalate if the request crosses legal or compliance boundaries.

style_sources.name: hr_tone_guide.docx
style_sources.content_excerpt: Empathetic tone, neutral language, and manager-ready recommendations.

factual_sources.name: incident_summary.txt
factual_sources.content_excerpt: Sanitized timeline, policy references, and unresolved evidence gaps.
factual_sources.purpose: Approved incident facts for HR review

scenarios.title: Custom persona and custom task with no grounding
scenarios.custom_task_text: Draft a board-ready vendor risk memo for a procurement steering committee.
scenarios.job_role: Vendor risk lead coordinating procurement, legal, and security reviewers for major software purchases.
scenarios.additional_context: Use plain business English and make all information gaps explicit before giving a recommendation.
